title: Zs Totem
description: A high-quality 3D Totem of Undying texture that adds depth, realism, and style to Minecraft gameplay.
body:
The 3D Totem texture pack upgrades the Totem of Undying with a fully modeled 3D design, adding depth, detail, and a more premium appearance. The totem features clean geometry and smooth textures, making it stand out while remaining instantly recognizable during gameplay.

Designed to blend seamlessly with Minecraft’s vanilla style, this texture enhances both survival and PvP experiences without affecting performance. It’s ideal for players who want a more immersive and high-quality look for one of the most important items in the game.

Features

Fully modeled 3D Totem of Undying

Enhanced depth and detailed design

Clear and recognizable in PvP situations

Vanilla-friendly visual style

Performance-optimized and lightweight

Suitable for survival, PvP, and multiplayer servers
